title: Appleseed Audiobook MEG
description: Magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings from 12 participants listening to continuous narrative speech, plus an empty-room recording, organized in BIDS format. The dataset was collected to test whether speech processing relies on local, context-independent predictive models, unified predictive models, or both in parallel. It includes stimulus annotations, gammatone features, and derivatives such as FreeSurfer outputs, predictor objects, and processing scripts.
methods_description: MEG data were recorded in FIFF format while participants listened to continuous narrative speech and processed with MNE-Python. MRI data are not subject-specific scans but derive from the fsaverage template with subject-specific scaling parameters. Stimuli are accompanied by Praat TextGrid annotations and gammatone feature files.
